lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement displays a staggered grid where the uppermost spots are offset posteriorly relative to the mid-flank clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a structured matrix across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance appendages (remoras) are attached to the ventral-lateral body wall inferior to the pectoral fin base.
